_comment: AGR's intervention pool (spec v5), rebuilt as OPERATIONAL DECISIONS (2026-10-04) and given explicit TARGETS (2026-10-05). Cards are data; lib/agr-deck.js checks and normalises them at load, lib/state.js agrResolve() applies the gain and agrApplyOne() each trade-off effect. Three are drawn per round from the enabled set — by risk pool from Round 2 (agr_risk_pool_by_round) — minus last round's draw when enough remain. AGR owns and plays every card (owner_sector); `origin_sector` is narrative only. Each half — `gain` and `tradeoff` — declares who it affects on its own: `target_type` SELF | SECTOR | MULTI | ALL | PICK | LOWEST | RANDOM2, `target_sectors`, and `effects[]` naming a sector or a token (AGR, POW…, ALL, CHOSEN, LOWEST) per effect, with its own amount — so a gain can land on MED while the trade-off lands on AGR, or on the chosen sector and AGR at once, or on every sector. Nothing lands on AGR merely because AGR played the card. `summary` is the TEACHING copy a table sees in R0–R1, when no consequence is enforced; `description` is the OPERATIONAL copy from the round the mechanic activates (agr_consequences_from_round), and only then are the trade-offs shown or applied. Card UI v3 (2026-10-04): `short_description` is the two-sentence face copy, `action_label` the confirm button's own verb, `target_label` the selector's word; the GAIN / TRADE-OFF lines and the AFFECTS labels a table reads are DERIVED from the two halves by lib/agr-copy.js and are never written here. Disable one with the scenario key agr_disabled_cards.

cards.title: ATMOSPHERIC BIOFILTER FLUSH
cards.short_description: AGR can run its city-wide biofilter network at maximum output to stabilise every active sector.
cards.description: AGR's canopy bio-filters scrub the air for the whole city. A full flush — running every filter bed to exhaustion at once — clears the particulate load from every sector's air handling in a single cycle. Every sector clears its galleries while its air is cycled, the beds are spent by it, and regrowing them draws on the water network for the next cycle.
cards.consequence_text: Every sector has 1 fewer available worker until the round ends; AGR loses 8 Integrity; WTR requires +1 Water at its next upkeep.

cards.title: OPEN THE CONTINGENCY STORES
cards.short_description: AGR can open the Seed Vault contingency stores and release its emergency reserves.
cards.summary: AGR gains +5 Power, +5 Water, +2 Med, +1 Parts.
cards.description: Sealed contingency stores sit beneath the Seed Vault, pre-positioned for a vault breach so the vault could be held without outside supply. AGR can open them now and draw everything down. Once open, the vault has no held reserve: that reserve was the city's insurance, not Agriculture's, and the stores must be re-sealed and restocked.
cards.consequence_text: AGR loses 6 Integrity and every sector loses 2 Integrity now; AGR requires +1 Power and +1 Water at its next upkeep.

cards.title: WORKFORCE RECOVERY
cards.short_description: AGR can bring one unavailable, non-injured worker back onto the roster.

cards.title: BACK-FEED THE LIGHTING RESERVE
cards.short_description: Power Grid is short on supply. AGR can back-feed its grow-light reserve into POW.
cards.description: The grow-light arrays sit on their own sub-grid with a buffered reserve held for lamp start-up surges. Power Grid is short, and AGR can back-feed that reserve across the tie-line now. The lamps will run off AGR's own stock until the buffer is recharged.
cards.consequence_text: AGR requires +1 Power at its next upkeep.

cards.title: DIVERT THE IRRIGATION HEADER
cards.short_description: WTR needs emergency supply. AGR can divert its irrigation reserve to the city water network.
cards.description: The irrigation header tank holds a standing reserve so the bays can ride out a short supply interruption. Water & Filtration needs it more than the bays do right now, and AGR can divert the whole header. The bays will run on reduced irrigation until the tank is back to level, which takes two cycles.
cards.consequence_text: AGR requires +1 Water at each of its next two upkeeps.

cards.title: CONVERT A BAY TO MEDICINAL STOCK
cards.short_description: MED needs more treatment capacity. AGR can convert one bay to medicinal production.
cards.summary: MED gains +1 healing capacity this round. MED still performs the heal.
cards.description: Medical Bay is treating more injured workers than its processing line can clear. AGR can convert one active hydroponic bay to fast-growing medicinal stock and run the processing on-site. The specialist crop improves MED's treatment capacity immediately, but the processing line needs a Medical hand to run it for the rest of the round.
cards.immediate_gain: MED +1 healing capacity this round. MED still performs the heal.
cards.consequence_text: MED has 1 fewer available worker until the round ends.

cards.title: RELEASE THE FREIGHT SLOT
cards.short_description: AGR can lend its reserved freight slot to TRN for one additional movement this round.
cards.summary: TRN gains +1 transfer approval this round. TRN still approves.
cards.description: AGR holds a standing slot on the tunnel freight schedule for produce movements. Transport can borrow that slot to clear one additional transfer this round. The schedule is finite, so using the slot now means Transport will operate one movement short in the next round.
cards.consequence_text: TRN has 1 fewer transfer approval next round.
cards.special_condition: TRN must agree to the freight-slot arrangement.

cards.title: DEPLOY THE REMEDIATION CREW
cards.short_description: AGR can deploy its remediation crew to the sector currently in the worst condition.
cards.summary: The active sector with the lowest Health gains +20 Health.
cards.description: One sector is in worse condition than any other and losing ground. AGR can send its full field crew with bio-remediation stock to that sector for the rest of the cycle. While they are away, AGR's own bays run unattended, and unattended bays degrade.
cards.immediate_gain: The active sector with the lowest Health +20 Health.

cards.title: TARGETED ENVIRONMENTAL PURGE
cards.short_description: AGR can route a sector's air through its canopy bio-filters to stabilise its systems.
cards.summary: Choose 1 active sector and restore +15 Health.
cards.description: A sector's air handling is loading up with particulate and its systems are suffering for it. AGR can route that sector's air through its canopy bio-filters for an extended purge cycle. The purge runs the pumps and the lamp banks hard for the whole cycle, and the sector's crew stands clear of the purged galleries while it runs.
cards.consequence_text: AGR requires +1 Power and +1 Water at its next upkeep; the chosen sector has 1 fewer available worker until the round ends.

cards.title: STRIP THE RESERVE RACKS
cards.short_description: AGR can strip reserve growing racks for pumps, valves and controllers needed immediately.
cards.description: Three growing racks are held in reserve, fully fitted but unplanted. AGR can strip their serviceable pumps, valves and controllers for immediate use. The stripped racks will fail their next inspection, and AGR's reserve capacity is counted against it.
cards.consequence_text: AGR loses 6 Integrity at the start of the next round.

cards.title: SECOND A TECHNICIAN
cards.short_description: A sector is overloaded. AGR can send one technician to assist for the rest of the round.
cards.summary: Choose 1 sector to receive +1 temporary worker until the round ends.
cards.description: A sector has more open work than hands. AGR can second one of its bay technicians for the rest of the round; the technician carries their own tools and needs no briefing. The bays they leave behind run one short until they return.
cards.immediate_gain: Chosen sector +1 worker until the round ends.
cards.consequence_text: AGR has 1 fewer available worker until the round ends.

cards.title: BREAK A CACHE SEAL
cards.short_description: AGR can break one sealed emergency cache to cover an immediate resource shortage.
cards.summary: Choose one resource type and gain an emergency cache.
cards.description: Four sealed emergency caches sit behind the nursery bays, each stocked for one specific shortage. AGR can break one seal and draw it down now. A broken cache must be restocked from AGR's own supply at the next resupply point, or it stays empty for the rest of the shift.
cards.immediate_gain: Choice of +3 Power, +3 Water, +2 Med or +2 Parts.
cards.consequence_text: AGR requires +1 of the chosen resource at its next upkeep.
